about_short_description.short_description: Airbyte is an open-source data integration engine that helps to sync data from applications to warehouses.

product.name: Airbyte Data Integration Platform
product.description: An open-source data integration platform for replicating data between applications, databases, warehouses, lakes, and analytics systems.

product.name: Airbyte Agents
product.description: An agent data and action layer that connects AI agents to business applications, enabling cross-system searches, real-time reads, and write actions.

product.name: Airbyte Context Store
product.description: A managed, searchable layer that replicates selected business entities from connected systems so AI agents can retrieve unified cross-system context.

product.name: Airbyte Enterprise Data Integration Services
product.description: Managed and self-managed data integration offerings with enterprise governance, support, security controls, and reliability features for business-critical workloads.
